snippet.title: Sage: Psychic Spy - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4735420/Sage_Psychic_Spy/

Sage: Psychic Spy is a stealth action-adventure game inspired by classics from the 6th-gen console era. Sneak deep into enemy territory, read minds to gain intel, and use telekinesis to manipulate your enemies and environment.
